content: {"episode_id":"ep-05027","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for the denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) under CO-197 for missing prior authorization. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness, prompting evaluation for an underlying arrhythmic etiology. Given the history of documented supraventricular tachycardia, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm and assess for recurrent paroxysmal tachyarrhythmias."}
